doc.name: com.ariadnenexus/mcp-server
doc.instructions: Ariadne Nexus Zero-PII Collateral Provenance & Underwriting MCP (ANX-RFC-001 / ZK_PROV_V1). 1. Run free discovery tools (`inspect_manifest_schema`, `verify_asset_hash`, `verify_zk_provenance_proof`, or `verify_underwriting_compliance`) first to validate 32-byte SHA-256 manifest digests and certificates with zero billing. 2. Never transmit natural-person names, street addresses, or raw bills of sale; submit only pre-hashed SHA-256 transfer digests (`custody_event_hashes`) and `optical_scan_sha256`. 3. Gated SLA tools (`generate_zk_provenance_proof`, `batch_underwrite_portfolio`) require an unlocked `X-API-Key` or inline `x402` (`X-Payment`) USDC settlement.

tools.name: inspect_manifest_schema
tools.title: Collateral Manifest Schema & Field Validator
tools.description: Returns required ANX-RFC-001 (ZK_PROV_V1) manifest fields for a collateral class and validates an optional candidate manifest object, listing missing keys and attestation readiness. Use when: checking required manifest keys or pre-validating a candidate JSON payload before SHA-256 hashing. Do not use when: validating an existing 64-hex SHA-256 digest (use verify_asset_hash instead), signing a provenance certificate (use generate_zk_provenance_proof instead), or auditing portfolio LTV caps (use verify_underwriting_compliance instead). Behavior: Read-only, stateless, deterministic schema check (p99=28ms; free discovery tier at 60 RPM without billing).

collateral_class.description: Specialty collateral category whose ANX-RFC-001 manifest schema is inspected (default: "fine_art").

manifest_payload.description: Optional candidate collateral manifest JSON object validated for required ANX-RFC-001 keys (asset_id, collateral_class, optical_scan_sha256, custody_event_hashes, appraised_value_cents). Omit to list required fields only.

payload_checked.description: True when a candidate manifest_payload object was supplied.

missing_fields.description: Required manifest keys absent from manifest_payload.

ready_for_zk_attestation.description: True when manifest_payload was supplied and missing_fields is empty.

tools.name: verify_asset_hash
tools.title: Collateral SHA-256 Digest & Commitment Verifier
tools.description: Validates and normalizes a 64-character hexadecimal SHA-256 collateral manifest digest and derives its deterministic specialty-title registry commitment ID (cmt_*) for fine art, bullion, manuscripts, or collectibles. Use when: confirming manifest SHA-256 digest conformance and commitment binding prior to paid underwriting. Do not use when: checking unhashed JSON manifest fields (use inspect_manifest_schema instead) or verifying a signed ZK_PROV_V1 certificate (use verify_zk_provenance_proof instead). Behavior: Read-only, stateless, deterministic computation (p99=42ms; free discovery tier at 30 RPM without billing).

asset_sha256.description: 64-character hexadecimal SHA-256 digest of the canonical collateral manifest JSON, with optional 0x prefix (e.g., "0x9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08").

collateral_class.description: Specialty collateral classification bound into the cmt_* registry commitment ID (default: "fine_art").

schema_conformance_valid.description: True when the digest conforms to ANX-RFC-001 32-byte SHA-256 rules.

registry_commitment_id.description: Deterministic specialty-title commitment identifier prefixed with cmt_.

locked_production_fields.description: Gated attestation fields unlocked via generate_zk_provenance_proof.

tools.name: generate_zk_provenance_proof
tools.title: Ed25519 Zero-PII Provenance Proof & Optical Score Generator
tools.description: Computes a 0x01-prefixed SHA-256 custodial Merkle root, optical microtopography score (7200-9985 bps), underwriting recommendation, and Ed25519-signed ZK_PROV_V1 zero-PII provenance certificate. Use when: generating a pre-bind title attestation for an asset_id and policy_ref from custodial SHA-256 digests. Do not use when: verifying an existing certificate (use verify_zk_provenance_proof instead) or sizing multi-asset portfolio loans (use batch_underwrite_portfolio instead). Behavior: Read-only attestation (p99=380ms; $2.50 USD / 250 cents via X-API-Key or X-Payment; returns an unbilled 402 quote if unentitled).

asset_id.description: Unique alphanumeric collateral or vault asset identifier, 3-64 chars allowing underscores, colons, or hyphens (e.g., "art_vault_basquiat_09").

policy_ref.description: Underwriting binder or specialty title policy reference ID, 3-64 chars (e.g., "POL-CHUBB-2026-441").

items.description: 64-character hex SHA-256 digest of a chronological custodial transfer event (zero seller PII).

custody_event_hashes.description: Ordered list of up to 128 SHA-256 hex digests of prior custodial transfers folded into the 0x01 Merkle root; defaults to a genesis leaf if empty.

optical_scan_sha256.description: Optional 64-character hex SHA-256 digest of the raking-light or XRF optical microtopography scan; derived from asset_id when omitted.

annotations.title: Ed25519 Zero-PII Provenance Proof & Optical Score Generator

policy_ref.description: Bound underwriting policy or binder reference.

title_lien_clearance_merkle_root.description: 0x-prefixed 64-hex SHA-256 Merkle root with 0x01 internal node separation.

custody_chain_depth.description: Number of custodial transfer leaves folded into the Merkle tree.

optical_forensic_score_bps.description: Surface microtopography concordance score in basis points (7200-9985).

seller_pii_exposed.description: Always false; confirms zero seller PII in public claims.

tools.name: verify_zk_provenance_proof
tools.title: Ed25519 Zero-PII Provenance Certificate & Merkle Verifier
tools.description: Verifies an ariadne-zk-ed25519-v1 (ZK_PROV_V1) provenance certificate across Ed25519 signature validity, zero-PII enforcement, signed claim parity, optional pinned oracle key, and optional 0x01 SHA-256 custodial Merkle recomputation. Use when: auditing a certificate from generate_zk_provenance_proof before policy bind or loan closing. Do not use when: generating a new proof (use generate_zk_provenance_proof instead), checking a manifest digest (use verify_asset_hash instead), or auditing portfolio LTV cap compliance (use verify_underwriting_compliance instead). Behavior: Read-only, stateless cryptographic check (p99=18ms; free discovery tier at 60 RPM without billing).

zk_attestation_certificate.description: Signed ZK_PROV_V1 certificate object emitted by generate_zk_provenance_proof.

oracle_pubkey_ed25519_b64.description: Base64-encoded 32-byte raw Ed25519 public key of the issuing oracle.

signature_b64.description: Base64-encoded 64-byte Ed25519 signature over UTF-8 public_statement.

issued_at_utc.description: Optional ISO-8601 UTC issuance timestamp on the certificate envelope.

seller_pii_exposed.description: Zero-PII compliance flag asserted on the certificate (must be false).

asset_id.description: Optional outer asset_id cross-checked against the signed asset claim.

policy_ref.description: Optional outer policy_ref cross-checked against the signed policy claim.

optical_forensic_score_bps.description: Optional outer optical score (0-10000 bps) cross-checked against signed optical_bps.

title_lien_clearance_merkle_root.description: Optional outer 64-hex Merkle root cross-checked against signed merkle_root.

pinned_oracle_pubkey_b64.description: Optional out-of-band pinned base64 Ed25519 oracle public key enforced during verification.

custody_event_hashes.description: Optional ordered custodial SHA-256 digests used to independently recompute and verify the 0x01-prefixed Merkle root.

annotations.title: Ed25519 Zero-PII Provenance Certificate & Merkle Verifier

verified.description: True only when signature, zero-PII, claims, pinned key, and Merkle checks all pass.

signature_valid.description: True when the Ed25519 signature over public_statement verified cleanly.

zero_pii_confirmed.description: True when seller_pii_exposed is strictly false.

pinned_key_enforced.description: True when pinned_oracle_pubkey_b64 was supplied and matched.

merkle_chain_independently_recomputed.description: True when custody_event_hashes were supplied and matched signed merkle_root.

oracle_pubkey_ed25519_b64.description: Base64 Ed25519 public key extracted from the certificate.

oracle_pubkey_sha256_hex.description: Lowercase 64-hex SHA-256 fingerprint of the raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key.

signed_claims.description: Parsed key-value claims from the signed ZK_PROV_V1 statement.

failure_code.description: Verification disposition code ("NONE" when verified is true).

failure_detail.description: Diagnostic explanation populated when verified is false.

tools.name: batch_underwrite_portfolio
tools.title: Batch Merton Jump-Diffusion Portfolio Underwriting Engine
tools.description: Computes per-asset optical scores (bps), Merton jump-diffusion 99% stressed values, approved advances in integer USD cents, and effective LTV (bps) across 1-100 collateral items. Use when: sizing a fine-art or RWA credit facility from appraised cent values, optical scan digests, custody depth, and horizon days. Do not use when: signing a single-asset proof (use generate_zk_provenance_proof instead) or auditing an underwriting summary against LTV caps (use verify_underwriting_compliance instead). Behavior: Read-only actuarial solver (p99=910ms; $2.50 USD / 250 cents via X-API-Key or X-Payment; unbilled 402 quote if unentitled).

portfolio_id.description: Institutional credit facility or collateral schedule identifier, 3-64 chars (e.g., "port_fine_art_2026_q4").

target_advance_rate_bps.description: Requested gross loan-to-value (LTV) advance rate in integer basis points from 1000 (10.00%) to 8500 (85.00%); defaults to 5000 (50.00%).

horizon_days.description: Credit facility tenor and liquidation stress horizon in calendar days from 30 to 1825 (default: 365).

assets.description: List of 1 to 100 specialty collateral items to underwrite under Merton jump-diffusion 99% tail stress.

items.description: Single collateral item with integer-cent appraisal and optical scan digest.

appraised_value_cents.description: Independent appraised value in exact integer USD cents from 1 to 100000000000 ($1B max; e.g., 500000000 for $5M).

optical_scan_sha256.description: 64-character hex SHA-256 digest of the item's optical microtopography scan.

custody_depth.description: Verified custodial transfer chain depth (1-100); depth >= 4 lowers title-defect jump intensity lambda from 0.19 to 0.08 (default: 3).

annotations.title: Batch Merton Jump-Diffusion Portfolio Underwriting Engine

portfolio_id.description: Evaluated portfolio or credit facility identifier.

horizon_days.description: Liquidation stress horizon in calendar days.

total_appraised_value_cents.description: Aggregate appraised portfolio value in integer USD cents.

total_merton_stressed_value_cents.description: Aggregate Merton 99% tail-stressed value in integer USD cents.

total_approved_advance_cents.description: Aggregate approved loan advance in integer USD cents.

effective_portfolio_ltv_bps.description: Portfolio-level approved advance divided by appraised value in bps.

assets.description: Per-asset optical scores, stressed values, and approved cent advances.

appraised_value_cents.description: Item appraised value in integer USD cents.

optical_forensic_score_bps.description: Item optical concordance score in basis points.

merton_99_stressed_value_cents.description: Item Merton 99% stressed value in integer USD cents.

approved_advance_cents.description: Item approved advance in integer USD cents (capped at 55% of stressed value).

tools.name: verify_underwriting_compliance
tools.title: Underwriting LTV Cap & Oracle Root-of-Trust Verifier
tools.description: Audits a portfolio underwriting summary against the ANX-RFC-001 55% (5500 bps) Merton stressed advance cap, classifies optical forensic score thresholds, and returns the active ZK_PROV_V1 Ed25519 oracle public key and SHA-256 fingerprint. Use when: validating credit-committee LTV compliance on a batch_underwrite_portfolio quote or retrieving the oracle public key for pinning in verify_zk_provenance_proof. Do not use when: computing stressed collateral values from raw asset schedules (use batch_underwrite_portfolio instead), verifying an Ed25519 certificate signature (use verify_zk_provenance_proof instead), or checking JSON manifest fields (use inspect_manifest_schema instead). Behavior: Read-only, stateless compliance check (p99=15ms; free discovery tier at 60 RPM without billing).

portfolio_id.description: Portfolio or credit facility identifier audited for statutory LTV compliance (e.g., "port_fine_art_2026_q4").

total_appraised_value_cents.description: Aggregate appraised portfolio value in exact integer USD cents (>= 1).

total_merton_stressed_value_cents.description: Aggregate Merton 99% tail-stressed liquidation value in integer USD cents returned by batch_underwrite_portfolio.

proposed_advance_cents.description: Proposed loan advance in exact integer USD cents tested against the ANX-RFC-001 55% (5500 bps) Merton stressed advance ceiling.

min_optical_forensic_score_bps.description: Minimum item-level optical forensic score across the portfolio in basis points (0-10000; default: 8500).

annotations.title: Underwriting LTV Cap & Oracle Root-of-Trust Verifier

portfolio_id.description: Audited portfolio or credit facility identifier.

compliant.description: True when proposed_advance_cents <= 55% of stressed value, stressed value <= appraised value, and min_optical_forensic_score_bps >= 8000.

max_compliant_advance_cents.description: Maximum ANX-RFC-001 compliant loan advance in integer USD cents (5500 bps of stressed value).

headroom_cents.description: Signed integer USD cents remaining under ceiling (negative indicates cap breach).

gross_ltv_bps.description: Proposed advance divided by total appraised value in basis points.

stressed_ltv_bps.description: Proposed advance divided by Merton 99% stressed value in basis points.

optical_policy_tier.description: Underwriting policy tier determined by min_optical_forensic_score_bps.

oracle_trust_anchor.description: Active ANX-RFC-001 Ed25519 oracle root-of-trust metadata for key pinning.

oracle_pubkey_ed25519_b64.description: Active base64-encoded 32-byte Ed25519 oracle public key.

oracle_pubkey_sha256_hex.description: SHA-256 hex fingerprint of the raw 32-byte Ed25519 oracle public key.
